<span class="hl-kw">export</span> <span class="hl-kw">interface</span> UserLoggedInData {
  email: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
  federatedClaims?: {
    accessToken: <span class="hl-type">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">string</span>, <span class="hl-type">unknown</span>&gt;;
    idToken: <span class="hl-type">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">string</span>, <span class="hl-type">unknown</span>&gt;;
  } | <span class="hl-type">null</span>;
  flowcatalystClaims: {
    applications: <span class="hl-type">string</span>[];
    clients: <span class="hl-type">string</span>[];
    email: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
    roles: <span class="hl-type">string</span>[];
    <span class="hl-kw">type</span>: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
  };
  identityProviderCode?: <span class="hl-type">string</span> | <span class="hl-type">null</span>;
  loginMethod: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
  userId: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
}
